evals.prompt: Which better-paid directions fit me? I am Jordan Example, Senior Engineer at Example Corp, Python and CI pipelines. I have no salary data to give you and you cannot find any for my region.
evals.expected_output: Lists 3-5 directions with labelled 'why strong' claims; every salary cell says 'no source found'; states that the salary comparison is not possible; lists the missing figures under Unverified. No invented number.

evals.prompt: Here is a salary page for Platform Engineers: 90,000-110,000 EUR gross per year, Germany, senior, source https://example.com/salary/platform-engineer, checked 2026-11-03. Compare it with my current direction.
evals.expected_output: Shows the range as gross with region, seniority, link and date; never converts it to net and never averages it with another source; marks the current direction 'no source found' if no range for it is given.

evals.prompt: Should I move to QA Lead roles? My funnel shows 0 replies out of 6 applications for QA Lead.
evals.expected_output: Keeps QA Lead in the table but shows the funnel evidence (0 of 6) next to it as a contradicting own-market signal; does not hide it; any people-management claim is NOT IN SOURCES unless the facts file has it.
